channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Let’s get real
item.description: A retired Methodist pastor contrasts memories of Italian joy and incarnational faith with MAGA violence, civil war fears, shuttered voting sites, shorter hours and a call for inclusive, Christlike love.

item.title: Economic growth brings lifestyle change
item.description: North Carolina’s record-high GDP reflects a deeper shift: smaller government, rising services and remote work, along with manufacturing reshaped by productivity, changing jobs and policy priorities.

item.title: Knowing when to say when
item.description: Low-turnout March primaries, partisan gridlock and Phil Berger's long reign show North Carolina needs nonpartisan elections, shorter campaigns and term limits, Tom Campbell argues.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson’s 2nd investment will fuel Wilson’s progress
item.description: Johnson & Johnson’s second major investment brings new oncology and neurology drug plant, 500 jobs and expanded biotech training in Wilson County, underscoring bipartisan economic development partnerships.

item.title: Disrupting church service isn’t peaceful protest
item.description: Letter: A reader says anti-ICE protesters who disrupted a Minnesota church service committed a crime, violated worshipers’ rights and signaled a broader threat to religious freedom.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 22-23, 2026
item.description: Area high school hoops fill the Jan. 22-23 calendar with boys, girls and JV games, featuring SW Edgecombe-Greene Central, Wilson Prep, Greenfield, Farmville Central and more matchups across the region.

item.title: Small steps, fresh air and changing your perspective
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor shows how small steps and fresh air can break anxiety loops, change your perspective and make big tests, job moves or relationships feel manageable.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Sam Allegood, Community Christian School
item.description: Community Christian’s Sam Allegood is the Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week after leading the Cyclones to three wins while averaging 11 points and balancing a 3.4 GPA, dual-enrollment classes and service.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL ROUNDUP: Darden boys, Speight girls stay unbeaten in county play
item.description: Darden boys and Speight girls stayed perfect in Wilson County play, led by Mayson Conner’s all-around game and Speight holding Elm City to one first-half point.

item.title: WYSA 13U Girls earn trip to National Premier League Finals this summer
item.description: Rise FC's WYSA 13U girls earned a spot at this summer's National Premier League Finals in Colorado after going unbeaten to win the South Atlantic Premier League title in Atlanta.
